handle_rerank_text_decoder: handle text-only Qwen3 reranker requests using score_prompts with yes/no token scoring
handle_rerank_vl_decoder: handle multimodal Qwen3-VL reranker requests using generation with logprobs for image and video content
detect_rerank_backend: detect the rerank backend type (vl_decoder, text_decoder, or cross_encoder) from model path and chat template
build_rerank_response: build a sorted RerankResponse list from scores with optional top_n limit and document inclusion
extract_score_from_logprobs: extract reranking score from generation logprobs by computing yes/no probability ratio
